descriptions.d11b_init_mouse_802853f0: For nonzero initialize and priority 65535, initialize the MouseEntity registry with the original factory, parent descriptor and flags 9/0. Initialize Input.MouseMoved and Input.MouseMoved.Captured name caches, then construct separate min (-320,-240,0) and max (320,240,0) vectors. Preserve registration and cache order, original callback identity and all global addresses. Partial registry/cache views; no complete class-size claim. Owns compiler float literals independently decoded from original DOL and requiring parent review; referenced mutable objects remain external.
